summary: Validated live mobile preview, dashboard branding, menu preload, sale modal, and core persistence/accounting APIs. Backend regression passed; several requested production flows are not implemented.

critical.issue: Update replaces the document fields without preserving kind='menu'; subsequent GET /api/menu filters it out, so edited items disappear.

integration_issues.issue: UI always submits exactly one item; requested multiple-item order entry is unavailable.
No export controls are rendered; backend only exposes CSV and no PDF endpoint.
No camera/photo picker or receipt upload flow is present.
No Google login or Settings screen is present.
Items screen has add only; no edit/delete confirmation UI to use the menu PUT/DELETE APIs.

issues: Screen is hard-coded to current month and has no date-range controls or export actions.

action_items: Preserve kind='menu' in PUT /api/menu/{item_id} and verify edited item remains listed.
Implement multi-item sale entry with portion selection, receipt capture, PDF/CSV export, reports date range, Google login/settings, and edit/delete confirmations.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the environment contract specifies EXPO_BACKEND_URL; align naming or provide a deliberate compatibility mapping.
Interactive controls do not expose testID/data-testid attributes, reducing reliable automated coverage.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (preview/navigation/modal/menu checks passed; requested missing flows unresolved)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST-prefixed temporary order, purchase, and expense for regression verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live preview is http://localhost:3000; backend URL is configured via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Existing preview data included orders, but temporary test records were cleaned up.
rca_of_issue: Menu PUT builds a replacement field dictionary from the Pydantic model and omits the discriminator used by GET /menu's kind='menu' filter. Reproduce by PUT an existing item, then GET /api/menu; the item is absent. Frontend gaps are structural: index.tsx contains only six tabs and a single-item EntryModal, with no receipt, export, auth, settings, or edit controls.
